input.narration: The user opened the dashboard and navigated to the reports page. They clicked Export CSV twice, and both attempts failed with a 500 Internal Server Error. After the second failure they left the page without exporting.

findings.title: CSV export fails with a 500 error
findings.evidence: User clicked Export CSV twice on the reports page and both attempts returned a 500 Internal Server Error before they abandoned.

input.narration: The user landed on the integrations page and searched three times for a Slack integration with increasingly specific queries. Finding no result, they clicked the Request Slack integration button. They then left the page, unable to connect Slack.

findings.title: No Slack integration available
findings.evidence: User searched for Slack three different ways, found nothing, and clicked Request Slack integration before leaving.

input.narration: The user opened the billing page and clicked Update card. They submitted the payment-method form and the card was updated successfully. They left the page once the update completed.

The user moved from onboarding step one to step two and tried to continue. The continue action failed twice with a 'Phone number is required' validation error, and the user rage-clicked in frustration. They abandoned onboarding on step two without completing it.

findings.title: Onboarding blocked by phone validation error
findings.evidence: User hit 'Phone number is required' twice on step 2, rage-clicked, and abandoned onboarding.

findings.title: Required phone field is not clearly marked
findings.evidence: User repeatedly failed the phone validation, suggesting the required field was not obvious before submitting.

input.narration: The user returned to the reports page and clicked Export CSV, which failed again with a 500 Internal Server Error. They opened support chat and sent a message saying the export was still broken. They left the page without a working export.

findings.title: CSV export still failing (500); user escalated to support
findings.evidence: Export failed with a 500 error again and the user opened support chat with the message 'Export still broken!'

input.narration: The user opened the reports page, applied a last-30-days date filter, and generated a report. They clicked Export CSV and the download completed successfully. They left the page after exporting.

The user opened team settings and submitted an invite for a new member. The invite failed with a 'Seat limit reached' error and no upgrade option was offered. They left the page unable to add a teammate.

findings.title: No upgrade path shown when the seat limit is reached
findings.evidence: Invite failed with 'Seat limit reached' and the user was offered no way to add seats or upgrade before leaving.

input.narration: The user opened the help center and searched for how to bulk delete records using two different phrasings. Both searches returned no results and they opened no articles. They left the help center without finding an answer.

findings.title: Help center search returns no results for common queries
findings.evidence: User searched 'bulk delete' and 'delete many records' and both returned no results.

input.narration: The user opened the dashboard, which appeared to load slowly. They refreshed the page three times over two minutes while the widgets stayed blank. They left the dashboard without the data ever loading.

findings.title: Dashboard widgets fail to load
findings.evidence: User refreshed the dashboard three times in two minutes with widgets staying blank, then left.

input.narration: The user moved through all three onboarding steps, submitting each form without errors. They reached the dashboard and viewed their first report. They continued into the app after completing onboarding.
The user opened the API keys page and clicked Generate key. Nothing appeared after the click, and they pressed Generate key two more times with no result. They left the page without an API key.

findings.title: Generate API key button is unresponsive
findings.evidence: User clicked Generate key three times with no key produced and then left the page.

input.narration: The user opened notification settings and toggled email alerts off. They clicked Save and the change failed with a 'Could not save settings' error. They left settings without the change being saved.

findings.title: Notification settings fail to save
findings.evidence: Toggling email alerts off and clicking Save returned a 'Could not save settings' error.

input.narration: The user visited the account, security, and billing pages in turn, apparently looking for a way to delete their account. They searched for 'delete account' but found no delete option on any page. They left settings without locating the control.

findings.title: Account deletion control is hard to find
findings.evidence: User checked account, security, and billing pages and searched 'delete account' without finding a delete option.

input.narration: The user opened the upgrade page and selected the Pro plan. On the payment form the card was declined with a 'Card verification failed' error, and they retried once with the same result. They left the upgrade flow without completing the purchase.

findings.title: Upgrade payment fails with a card verification error
findings.evidence: User selected the Pro plan and the payment form returned 'Card verification failed' on two attempts before they abandoned the upgrade.

input.narration: The user opened the reports page and applied a status filter to narrow the results. They exported the filtered report to CSV and the download succeeded. They left the page after a successful export.

The user opened the dashboard on Mobile Safari and tapped the Menu button, which never opened. They tapped Menu two more times and then rage-clicked with no response. They left the app without reaching any other page.

findings.title: Navigation menu does not open on mobile
findings.evidence: A Mobile Safari user tapped the Menu button three times and rage-clicked without the menu ever opening.

input.narration: The user opened webhook settings and saved a new webhook endpoint. They clicked Send test event twice, and both deliveries failed with a timeout after ten seconds. They left the page without a working webhook.

findings.title: Webhook test deliveries time out
findings.evidence: Both Send test event attempts on a newly saved endpoint failed with a ten-second timeout.

input.narration: The user opened the integrations page and started connecting Google Sheets. They completed the OAuth authorization and the integration was marked connected. They left the page after the successful setup.

The user opened security settings and searched for saml and then single sign-on, with both searches returning no results. They clicked Request SSO/SAML. They left the page unable to configure single sign-on for their team.

findings.title: No SSO / SAML login available
findings.evidence: User searched security settings for saml and single sign-on, got no results, and filed a request for SSO/SAML support.

input.narration: The user opened the reports page and applied a last-90-days date filter, but the report kept loading without completing. They refreshed the page, which cleared their filter, and had to reapply it before the report finally generated after a long wait. They left the page as soon as the report loaded.

findings.title: Report generation is slow for large date ranges
findings.evidence: A last-90-days report kept the user waiting so long they refreshed, and it still took minutes end to end.

findings.title: Filter selection resets on page refresh
findings.evidence: Refreshing the reports page cleared the user's applied date filter and forced them to reapply it.

input.narration: The user opened the reports page and searched for a way to schedule a report. The search returned no results and they clicked Request scheduled reports. They left the page without setting up a schedule.

findings.title: No way to schedule recurring reports
findings.evidence: User searched for report scheduling, found nothing, and clicked Request scheduled reports before leaving.

input.narration: The user clicked Forgot password on the login page and submitted the reset form. Receiving nothing, they submitted the form again and then opened support chat to say no reset email had arrived. They left without regaining access to their account.

findings.title: Password reset email never arrives
findings.evidence: User submitted the reset form twice, received no email, and told support no reset email had arrived.

input.narration: The user opened notification settings and toggled the weekly digest on. They clicked Save and the change was saved successfully. They left settings with the digest enabled.
The user opened the records page and searched for import csv, which returned no results. They then created three records one at a time by hand. They left the page after finishing the manual entry.

findings.title: No CSV import for bulk record creation
findings.evidence: User searched for import csv, found nothing, and manually created three records one at a time.

input.narration: The user opened a shared report link and received a 404 Not Found error. They refreshed twice and hit the same 404 each time. They left without ever seeing the shared report.

findings.title: Shared report links return a 404
findings.evidence: A shared report URL returned 404 Not Found on load and after two refreshes.
